collision energy: Fragmentation conditions in the LTQ were as follows: normalized collision energy, 40%
enrichment method: At the same time, an m7GTP-Sepharose enrichment was performed to determine the effect of viral infection on the composition of eIF4E-containing cap-binding complexes
fractionation method: gel lane was cut into 10 slices
For the whole cell lysate experiments, the gel lane was cut into 10 slices and each slice subjected to in-gel tryptic digestion
instrument: The resulting peptides were fractionated using an Ultimate 3000 nanoHPLC system in line with an LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
ionization type: Peptides were ionized by nanoelectrospray ionization at 2.1 kV
labeling: A SILAC-based mass spectrometry approach was employed to analyze changes to protein abundance
mass analyzer: the top six multipley charged ions in each duty cycle selected for MS/MS in the LTQ linear ion trap.
precursor tolerance: Peptide precursor mass tolerance was set at 4.5 ppm, and MS/MS tolerance was set at 0.5 Da.
fragment tolerance: Peptide precursor mass tolerance was set at 4.5 ppm, and MS/MS tolerance was set at 0.5 Da.
ptm: carbaminomethylation of cysteine (fixed); Oxidation of methionine (variable); N-terminal acetylation (variable)
Search criteria included carbaminomethylation of cysteine as a fixed modification. Oxidation of methionine and N-terminal acetylation were selected as variable modifications.
